summary: Iteration 17: Tested 5 new features: (1) SB/BB/D inline badges on PlayerSeat avatars, (2) no standalone floating D button, (3) History page PlayingCard graphics for community+hole cards, (4) effective-stack betting cap (raise/all-in capped at opp_max), (5) mid-game joiner (sitting_out) excluded from assignment denominator and ready_next_hand quorum. All 14 backend tests pass (100%). All 9 frontend features verified via browser automation and screenshots.

feature_verification.sb_bb_d_badges: PASS: D badge (gray #e2e8f0), SB badge (amber #f59e0b), BB badge (cyan #00f0ff) all visible as inline pills below player chips during PREFLOP. Verified via JS DOM query: [{text:BB, bg:rgb(0,240,255)}, {text:D, bg:rgb(226,232,240)}, {text:SB, bg:rgb(245,158,11)}]. Heads-up: AceKing has D+SB, BluffMaster has BB.
feature_verification.no_standalone_d_button: PASS: No standalone floating D button found. Badge row is rendered inline inside PlayerSeat component using small pill divs below chips. Code review confirmed: standalone D button block removed, isDealer/isSB/isBB props passed to all 3 PlayerSeat usages.
feature_verification.history_community_cards_playingcard: PASS: BOARD 1/2/3 labels visible in expanded hand. Community cards rendered as PlayingCard components showing rank+suit (e.g., 10♥, K♣, A♦). Suit symbols (♥♣♦♠) verified in page text.
feature_verification.history_hole_cards_playingcard: PASS: Each player's assigned hole cards per board shown as PlayingCard graphics (e.g., AceKing: Q♦,10♠ on Board 1; BluffMaster: J♥,2♣). assignments field stored and rendered correctly.
feature_verification.raise_max_capped_unit: PASS: 6 unit tests for game_engine.valid_actions with opp_max: raise max capped at opp_max when opp has fewer chips, all_in capped at opp_max, no cap when opp has more chips.
feature_verification.raise_max_capped_integration: PASS: Integration test with starting_chips=300 verifies raise max <= 300 (opponent effective stack). UI raise slider max=150 (pot-limit formula) <= 500 (starting chips) verified.
feature_verification.allin_capped: PASS: Unit test confirms all_in amount = min(player_total, opp_max) when opp has fewer chips.
feature_verification.midgame_joiner_sitting_out: PASS: CardShark joining mid-game has status=sitting_out confirmed via GET /api/tables/{id}.
feature_verification.sitting_out_no_assignment_block: PASS: sitting_out player not counted in assignment denominator (only active/all_in players). Frontend PokerTable.tsx line 1043: players.filter(p => ['active','all_in'].includes(p.status)).length confirmed in code review.
feature_verification.sitting_out_no_quorum_block: PASS: ready_next_hand quorum uses participated_uids = {p.user_id for p in room.players if p.status != 'sitting_out'}. Two active players vote → next hand starts without waiting for sitting_out joiner.
feature_verification.basic_game_flow: PASS: Full game flow tested: create table → join × 2 → start → preflop call/check → flop → turn → river → assignment phase → card assignment submission → showdown → board_winners computed → next hand.

critical_code_review_comments: Effective stack cap opp_max = max(q.chips + q.bet_street for q in active_opps) is correct: caps max raise/all-in at what opponents can call, preventing dead-money raises.
History.tsx gracefully falls back to winner-text for old records without assignments field (line 387: {!hand.assignments && ...}) - correct approach for backward compatibility.
PokerTable.tsx assignment denominator at line 1043 correctly uses ['active','all_in'].includes(p.status) to exclude sitting_out players.
server.py ready_next_hand quorum check (line 1161) correctly uses p.status != 'sitting_out' to exclude mid-game joiners from the quorum calculation.
PlayerSeat badges: all 3 render locations (opponent seats, my seat, spectator view) properly pass isDealer/isSB/isBB props based on round !== 'waiting' guard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 9 requested features verified (screenshots + code review + Playwright)
